name: Shayna Casada
occupation: Carbon County coroner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Shayna Casada is the Carbon County coroner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Brittany Nyman, who is serving through the current term. The Rawlins Times reported that she was among the county officials who won at the polls.

sources.name: Rawlins Times, Nov. 4, 2026, Carbon County sees no real surprises in 2026 midterm elections
